comments: This is a pre-screen, not a full conformance evaluation. It runs 7 automated checks on a single page and is explicit with users that automated testing cannot establish WCAG conformance on its own.
features: Free online pre-screen that checks a web page against 7 automated WCAG 2.2 AA criteria: image alt text, html lang attribute, single H1, heading order, visible focus indicator, button labels and form input labels. Returns a score and the list of issues found. Italian interface. Part of a wider website audit.
title: avstudio accessibility pre-screen
